title: Case Summary Render Data (段D)
description: Deterministic render contract for case-summary.template.html. The LLM emits ONLY this object (.case_summary_data.json) — never hand-written HTML — then scripts/render_html_template.py fills the template. Every key here maps to a {{placeholder}}, a <!-- LOOP --> array, or an i18n scaffold string in the template. The renderer is zero-medical: counts, fields, and locale all come from this data.

i18n.description: Scaffold strings for the chosen profile.json.locale, copied from the template's i18n string-table for that locale (or generated for an unlisted locale). Keys must cover every {{i18n.<key>}} placeholder in the template.

fallbacks.description: Per-placeholder fallback text used by the renderer when a scalar key is null/empty/missing. Key = placeholder name (e.g. 'labs_period', 'ecog'); value = locale-appropriate '资料缺失' wording. '__default__' is the catch-all used when no per-key fallback exists. Drives the 'every section always renders something' guarantee for scalar fields.

__default__.description: Catch-all fallback, e.g. zh '资料缺失'.

one_line_condition.description: Source-attributed header subtitle; no inferred stage, response, progression or prognosis.

stage.description: verbatim 分期 string from profile.summary.stage (or legacy flat profile.stage); may carry multi-layer / 待定 / two-hospital nuance; NEVER re-synthesized. null → 资料缺失 placeholder.

sex.description: Mapped via i18n.val_male / val_female; never raw M/F if locale wants words.

age.description: Age only when necessary for the artifact and supported by source; never DOB, birthplace or occupation. MUST carry its own as-of date inline — a bare number is a stale snapshot presented as current. Render the source snapshot with its date (zh: '52 岁（2024-03-11 报告）' / en: '52 (as of 2024-03-11)'); when patient_summary.demographics.birth_year is non-null an approximate current age may be shown BESIDE it, explicitly marked approximate (zh: '现约 55 岁' / en: 'approx. 55 now'), never replacing the dated snapshot. Wording comes from the locale string table per i18n.md §5, not hardcoded.

height_weight_bmi.description: '165 cm / 68 kg / 25.0' — values/units verbatim, BMI computed.

ecog.description: Clinician-reported ECOG only. Patient function descriptions are not converted to a score.

case_summary_narrative.description: 3–5 sentence source-attributed narrative; preserve source strings and add labeled translation if needed; no new medical judgment.

labs_period.description: Date range shown next to the labs section heading.

caveats.description: 0..N provenance caveats. Conflicts remain disputed; no model or patient adjudication selects a clinical winner.

caveat_text.description: Describe missing, OCR-uncertain, incompatible, or disputed source data without resolving it.

provenance.description: Source-reference side table for populated clinical render fields. The renderer ignores it, but the archive validator resolves every source_refs[] entry. field is a stable data path such as stage, lesions[0], molecular_rows[1], lab_trends[0], or treatment_lines[2].

lesions.description: 0..N lesion rows. Empty array → template renders the i18n.val_pending placeholder row (section never deleted).

lesion_site.description: Anatomic site (原发灶 / 肝转移 / 肺转移 / 淋巴结...).

molecular_rows.description: 0..N molecular dimension rows (驱动突变 / 免疫表型 / DDR 与其他 / 组织病理). Empty → placeholder row.

molecular_value.description: Source gene/variant/VAF/IHC retained; any validated normalization is additive and labeled.

trend_charts.description: 0..N neutral observation charts selected under cancer-trend-markers.md. Selection is not a clinical judgment and no series is labeled treatment response. Values are source-copied; deterministic code injects geometry.

series.description: At least two comparable source points. Values are copied from longitudinal_observations.json/labs.json without clinical interpretation.

treatment_markers.description: 0..N source-reported treatment-episode date markers on the same time axis. Temporal alignment does not imply causation or response.

reading_note.description: READING GUIDE — how to read this chart and whether the series is comparable (method changes, unit changes, data gaps, what the band is). Describes the DATA, never the disease. Must not state or imply response, progression, prognosis or any RECIST category; render_chart.py fails closed (exit 4) on verdict phrasing in authored text. Distinct from `interpretation`, which stays disabled.

reference_range.description: Reference range VERBATIM from THIS report for this analyte (e.g. '0-37', '<25'). Report-specific only — never a textbook or general value, because ranges differ by laboratory and method. Ambiguous forms (sex- or age-split) are left null rather than guessed. Absent/unparseable → no band is drawn and the summary says so explicitly, because a missing band and a band you happen to sit inside look identical otherwise.

reference_range_text.description: Injected by render_chart.py: the reference range as displayed. Empty when none was supplied.

has_band.description: Injected by render_chart.py: '1' when a reference band was computed, '' otherwise. Drives RENDER_IF in the template.

band_y.description: Injected by render_chart.py: y of the reference band top edge, same viewBox as svg_points. '' when no band.

band_h.description: Injected by render_chart.py: height of the reference band. '' when no band.

stroke.description: Injected: marker stroke from the CancerDAO token table. Amber outline = outside THIS report's reference range; critical red ONLY when the source report itself flagged the value.

fill.description: Injected: marker fill. Out-of-range points are outlined, never filled red — a screenful of red is a high-intensity anxiety signal, and being outside a reference interval is usually not clinically meaningful.

lab_trends.description: 0..N lab TREND rows (replaces the old flat latest-value grid). Each row = lab_name + verbatim series + current_value + status badge. compute_sparklines.py injects svg_points / direction / point_count. Empty → placeholder row (section never deleted). A row with a single timepoint renders no line (svg_points='') — the current_value + badge still show.

series.description: 0..N {t, v}. Values verbatim from longitudinal_observations.json / labs.json.

status_class.description: Derived only from the reporting laboratory's own flag/critical notation; never from a universal multiplier.

status_label.description: Source-reported laboratory flag; a labeled translation may be added without replacing it.

version_delta.description: 自上次总结的变化 strip, or null when there is no prior snapshot (first-ever summary → hidden). Produced by compute_version_delta.py, NOT the subagent — it diffs the current render data against the previous case_summary_versions/case_summary_data_<date>.json snapshot.

prev_date.description: report_date of the compared prior snapshot.

items.description: 0..N changes. Empty → a neutral '无关键变化' note renders.

text.description: Arithmetic/source change only, e.g. a copied value pair or newly documented treatment episode; no inferred line or clinical valence.

dir.description: Arithmetic direction only — carries NO clinical valence.

labs.description: Retired flat lab display; must be empty so legacy model-graded severity cannot re-enter the renderer.

treatment_lines.description: 0..N chronological source-reported treatment episodes. Empty → placeholder item.

line_label.description: Copy documented_line_label or phase_or_intent_source when present; otherwise use a neutral chronological episode label. Never infer a clinical line or intent.

line_badge_text.description: Source label only; no model-generated response or progression badge.

line_note.description: Clinician-reported response and reason_for_change_source only when documented, with source attribution; no imaging-derived response.
